title: Desktop app joins from a real invitation link, off the window's thread
spec: app::join_from_link parses the pasted InvitationLink (trimmed), fetches the server's root with ServerEndpoint::from_invitation (pinned to the link's fingerprint, bounded by JOIN_TIMEOUT) and returns the endpoint and code, with plain messages for a non-link, an address that is not valid, a server that does not prove the pinned root, and one that cannot be reached. Controller runs the Join and starts Enrollment on a short-lived thread: act(Enroll) returns at once and the result arrives through poll (T309's bad-link check now reads it from poll). main.rs uses join_from_link.
